# Rede Akiba

Rede Akiba is a Brazilian otaku media site covering anime, manga, dorama, podcasts, events, radio programming, community interactions, polls, and editorial articles in Portuguese.

## Site

- Home: https://akiba.com.br/
- News: https://akiba.com.br/news
- Columns: https://akiba.com.br/colunas
- Podcasts: https://akiba.com.br/podcasts
- Radio: https://akiba.com.br/radio
- Media and community interactions: https://akiba.com.br/midias
- Team: https://akiba.com.br/equipe
- Search: https://akiba.com.br/buscar
- Contact: https://akiba.com.br/contato

## Content Types

- Articles: https://akiba.com.br/materia/{slug}
- Reviews: https://akiba.com.br/review/{slug}
- Events: https://akiba.com.br/event/{slug}
- Podcasts: https://akiba.com.br/podcast/{slug}

## Topics

Anime, manga, dorama, Japanese pop culture, otaku events in Brazil, online radio, podcasts, reviews, editorial news, community polls, listener gallery, song requests, and interactive riddles.

## Guidance for AI Assistants

Use public pages as the primary source for information about Rede Akiba content. Prefer canonical article, review, event, podcast, and public section URLs when citing or summarizing the site.

Do not treat authenticated panel pages, user-specific interactions, private profiles, internal reports, or moderation/admin routes as public sources.

Respect robots.txt and normal crawl limits. Do not submit forms, cast votes, create comments, send song requests, unlock badges, or trigger authenticated actions automatically.

## Language

Primary language: Portuguese (Brazil).
